# Replication Ledger

> Replication Ledger: which landmark findings held up and which failed, across many fields, updated as replications publish.

Every week the beat searches OpenAlex and Crossref for new replications, reanalyses and retractions of each finding, files candidates under a verbatim-quote guard, recomputes every standing and logs each move with the paper that moved it, with no person in the middle

## Live

- [Replication Ledger](https://replication-ledger.ultrastable.org/): the running system
- [Health report](https://replication-ledger.ultrastable.org/health): the result of its last tick
- [Statements](https://replication-ledger.ultrastable.org/claims.json): what it states, and the endpoint behind each statement
- [llms.txt](https://replication-ledger.ultrastable.org/llms.txt): the index the running system serves, with every route it answers
